column3: With respect to the Casa Del Rey and Las Golondrinas Apartments Mortgage Loan (3.7%), the Casa Del Rey Apartments Mortgaged Property is comprised of two multifamily projects that are subject to CA Assembly Bill 1482 rent controls and the Los Angeles County (CA) Rent Stabilization and Tenant Protections Ordinance. Among other things, the related controls impose a maximum annual percentage rental rate increase based on the lesser of (A) 5%, plus the percentage change in the cost of living, of the lowest gross rental rate charged for the immediately preceding 12 months or (B) 10%; and, in addition, restrict no-fault evictions and require relocation assistance payments for no-fault evictions.
